name: adoption-profile-writing
description: Writes and rewrites adopter-facing copy about an adoptable dog or cat from the animal's own record. Applies a four-section format (ABOUT THIS PET, HOUSEHOLD FIT, TRAINING, GOOD TO KNOW), keeps serious incidents off the card and routes them to a staff conversation, keeps placement constraints, drops social and humanizing words, and checks each draft's headings, word count, and banned phrases with a bundled standard-library script.
